title: Mauritius Application for Removal of a Limited Liability Partnership from Register for the Purpose of Transferring its Registration to Another Country (Form S32(a)/F LLP8)
description: The Corporate and Business Registration Department (CBRD)'s "Application for Removal of Limited Liability Partnership from Register for the Purpose of Transferring its Registration to Another Country", Form S32(a)/F LLP8, prescribed under section 32 of the Limited Liability Partnerships Act 2016 and distributed directly and unauthenticated from the Department's own downloadable-forms page. An already-registered Limited Liability Partnership's partner(s) file this application to have the partnership removed from the Mauritius register so its registration can transfer to another country, identifying the existing record by its registered number and category, naming the proposed jurisdiction of transfer, confirming which supporting enclosures accompany the filing, and declaring on the partnership's behalf. This schema does not submit the filing itself; the live source and the Department's own current requirements are always authoritative. GovSchema is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the Government of Mauritius or its Corporate and Business Registration Department.

source.documentRef: APPLICATION FOR REMOVAL OF LIMITED LIABILITY PARTNERSHIP FROM REGISTER FOR THE PURPOSE OF TRANSFERRING ITS REGISTRATION TO ANOTHER COUNTRY (Section 32), Form S32(a)/F LLP8, Corporate and Business Registration Department, 1 page, text-layer PDF (no AcroForm annotations).

verification.notes: See VERIFICATION.md for the full write-up: source fetch/hash, extraction method (positional text-layer extraction plus a canvas render confirming three genuine checkboxes gating the enclosed-documents block, the first checkbox-modelled field on any CBRD schema in this registry), the two-box (not three-box) existing-record identification block shared with the LP7/LLP4 siblings, and the Full-Name-before-Signature partner-slot column order, the reverse of the LP7 sibling's own Signature-before-Full-Name column order.

steps.title: Section 32 — Existing Limited Liability Partnership Identification

fields.name: registeredNo
fields.label: Registered No.
fields.description: The Limited Liability Partnership's own registered number, printed in its own bordered box directly beneath the name entry, used by the Department to positively identify the existing record applying for removal. The same two-box identification pattern already established by the LP7 and LLP4 siblings (Category, Registered No.), not the three-box pattern (adding Date of Registration) used by the LLP5/LP5 change-of-name siblings.

fields.name: proposedJurisdictionOfTransfer
fields.label: Proposed Jurisdiction of Transfer
fields.description: The country to which the Limited Liability Partnership's registration will transfer once removed from the Mauritius register. Printed in its own centered bordered box directly beneath the Category/Registered No. boxes, confirmed via canvas render.

fields.name: enclosedDocumentaryEvidence
fields.label: Enclosed: Documentary Evidence (Sections 33 and 35)
fields.description: Confirms documentary evidence as required under sections 33 and 35 of the Limited Liability Partnerships Act 2016 is enclosed with this application. Printed as one of three small square checkboxes under the "Enclosed herewith:" heading — the first checkbox field modelled on any CBRD schema in this registry, confirmed by canvas render (every other CBRD schema modelled so far uses only ruled free-text lines or a signature grid, never a checkbox). Modelled required since sections 33 and 35 evidence is a statutory precondition for every filing under this form, unlike the FSC confirmation checkbox below, which the form itself states applies only conditionally.
fields.sourceRef: "Enclosed herewith: [ ] Documentary evidence as required under section 33 and 35 of the Act."

fields.name: enclosedMraConfirmation
fields.label: Enclosed: MRA No-Objection Confirmation
fields.description: Confirms written confirmation from the Mauritius Revenue Authority (MRA) that there is no objection to the Limited Liability Partnership being removed from the register is enclosed. Modelled required for the same reason as enclosedDocumentaryEvidence: the form states this confirmation unconditionally, without the "in case" qualifier attached to the FSC confirmation below.
fields.sourceRef: "[ ] Written confirmation from MRA that there is no objection to the Limited Liability Partnership being removed from the register."

fields.name: enclosedFscConfirmation
fields.label: Enclosed: FSC Confirmation (Category One Global Business License holders)
fields.description: Confirms written confirmation from the Financial Services Commission is enclosed, applicable only where the Limited Liability Partnership holds a Category One Global Business License. The form prints no separate discriminator field indicating whether the partnership holds such a license, so — following this registry's established convention of not inventing a field the source does not print (see the LP7 sibling's bounded-slot rationale) — this checkbox is modelled optional with no requiredWhen gate rather than gated on an invented license-status field.
fields.sourceRef: "[ ] Written confirmation from Financial Services Commission in case Limited Liability Partnership hold a Category One Global Business License."

fields.name: partner1FullName
fields.label: Partner 1 — Full Name
fields.description: At least one partner's full name and signature is a legal precondition of this application, so slot 1 is modelled required. The form prints a four-row "Partner (s)" grid with "Full Name(s)" as the left column and "Signature(s)" as the right column, with no accompanying count field or checkbox indicating how many rows are actually used, so slots 2-4 are modelled optional with no requiredWhen gate — the same bounded-slot convention already established by this registry's LP7/LP1/LLP1 schemas. Note the column order is the reverse of the LP7 sibling's own grid, which prints Signatures on the left and Full names on the right; confirmed independently on this form via each item's own x-position (Full Name(s) column at x≈58, Signature(s) column at x≈346).

fields.name: partner1Signature
fields.label: Partner 1 — Signature
fields.description: See partner1FullName's own description for this bounded slot's requiredness rationale and the column-order finding.
